# Catalog cards that print a rider with a fixed amount (scry N, learn,
# discover N, amass [subtype] N, the Ring tempts you) and declare none
# (#4978, ADR 0126's amendment of 2026-11-05). One "<card> | <rider> |
# <reason>" a line. TestRiderPurposesMatchThePrintedCard holds it both
# ways: a new undeclared rider fails until it is declared or listed here,
# and a line that no longer matches fails until it is deleted.
